description: Lists the outgoing webhooks of this WordPress install: id, name, trigger, delivery and mirror address, method and format, whether it is active, and how many mapping or condition rules it carries. These webhooks fire for EVERY webinar on the install, not only the one open in the chat. Read-only, it changes nothing. Use it when the host asks which integrations are wired, or before changing one (that is wi_save_webhook) or testing one (that is wi_test_webhook). Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

name: wi_list_webhooks
title: List the outgoing webhooks
